description: Create house.item_overview, the flat inventory listing with room and brand names resolved.
rationale: Written through replace_view rather than a create_object, because CREATE OR REPLACE is what every later change to it will use and the first version should be created by the same mechanism. Columns are enumerated, never SELECT *: a star is expanded once, at creation, so a later ADD COLUMN would never reach this view and nothing would say so.

intents.name: item_overview
intents.comment: Every item with its room and brand resolved to names, and the loss against purchase price where a current price is known.
intents.definition: SELECT i.item_id, i.category, i.name, b.name AS brand_name, r.name AS room_name, r.kind AS room_kind, i.purchase_date, i.purchase_price, i.current_price, i.current_price - i.purchase_price AS value_change FROM house.item AS i LEFT JOIN house.brand AS b ON b.brand_id = i.brand_id LEFT JOIN house.room AS r ON r.room_id = i.room_id
